name: Hyprland
summary: AI may be used locally to learn and to write patches you fully understand, with detailed disclosure. AI must not write PR descriptions or issues or post anything; autonomous agents and AI-generated tickets mean a permanent ban.

evidence.quote: Locally writing patches and/or new features, tests, etc.
This disclosure must be explicit and detailed.
If there is no human in the chain, your submission is invalid.
An AI model must not submit, write the description of, or in any other way interact with Pull Requests, Issues, or any other developer-facing communication channel.
For major offenses, e.g. a fully autonomous AI agent, AI-generated PR descriptions, AI-generated tickets, we will be issuing permanent bans without questions.
